gaps.section: Bloch conventions, configurations and finite fields
gaps.needs: Natural comparison of the three Bloch conventions with precise two-primary defects, configuration and repeated-point specialization maps, and finite-field Bloch groups, independent of the comparisons owned by HabiroNumberFields §§1.6 and 1.13.

gaps.section: Global arithmetic K-groups, étale comparisons and the cyclotomic Picard injection
gaps.needs: Finite K₂ of integer rings, Tate invariants, odd-primary K₃ structure and global H¹ comparison, Tate degree-two and K₂-torsion comparisons, and the stated twisted-coinvariant Keune injection with natural coefficient and restriction diagrams.

gaps.section: Completed unramified local K₃ and its integral regulator
gaps.needs: At every unramified p>3, a finite integral root-symbol presentation of the completed image of global K₃ and its p²-integral Coleman-normalized regulator, compatible with relations, field embeddings and transfer to trace on every semilocal factor.
